_meta.source: Oregon Department of Education Fiscal Transparency -- Actual Revenue Data
_meta.generated_note: Generated by scripts/build_school_funding.py from a locally-downloaded copy of ODE's statewide Actual Revenue Data CSV (not checked into this repo). Re-download the current year's CSV and re-run this script annually alongside the tax-rate data refresh.
_meta.bucketing_note: Local = source codes 1000-1999 (property tax plus other local revenue like investment earnings and fees). State = 3000-3999 (mainly the State School Fund and Common School Fund). Federal = 4000-4999. Other = 2000-2999 intermediate sources (county school funds, ESD pass-through funds) plus minor one-time items like sale of fixed assets. Beginning Fund Balance and Interfund Transfers are excluded from every total: neither is new revenue for the year.
_meta.swocc_note: Southwestern Oregon Community College does not appear in this K-12/ESD dataset -- it reports through a separate community college fiscal system, not ODE's K-12 Fiscal Transparency portal. No funding breakdown is available for it here.

tax_data_comparison.note: These come from two different fiscal years and two different measures (FY2024-25 actual receipts vs. FY2025-26 imposed tax roll), so a modest difference is expected, not an error.
